supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends moderately beyond the outer corners of the eyes, creating a distinct lateral shelf.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-pigmented, speckled muzzle and the very dark, near-black periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness of the lower lip with a noticeable structural droop in a neutral position.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, dark pigmentation spots (freckling) concentrated across the philtrum and lower muzzle area.
